acceptance.baseline_rule: The first human-approved main commit containing this foundation is the accepted baseline.

mission: Guide LLMs to choose, sequence, adapt, and stop engineering reasoning methods without re-teaching general engineering knowledge.
current_limits: No executable review engine is implemented.
No claim is made that Markdown guidance mechanically controls an LLM.
Structural CI does not prove semantic review quality.
No universal language/framework checklist is part of the core.
